scenes.text: Have you ever felt a sudden shiver, sensed a dark figure in the corner of your eye, and felt overwhelming dread out of nowhere?
You might think your house is haunted, but science says it's actually just a sound you can't even hear, called infrasound.

At nineteen hertz, these ultra-low waves match the natural resonant frequency of the human eyeball, vibrating your eyes to create ghostly peripheral illusions while triggering a massive panic response.
Have you ever felt a presence in an empty room, or do you think ghosts might actually be real? Let me know in the comments below!
